evals.prompt: How should I pick models in Cursor to save tokens this week?
evals.expected_output: 70% fast Composer, 20% strong when stuck, 10% Ask-only; escalation ladder from Ask to fast to strong.
expectations: Recommends roughly 70% fast Composer for implementation
Reserves strong model for stuck/architecture cases (~20%)
Uses Ask mode for read-only exploration (~10%)
Describes escalation rather than defaulting to strongest model

evals.prompt: Context ring is at 75% — should I keep going in this chat?
evals.expected_output: Recommend new chat for new scope; continue only for tight follow-ups; mention @ scoping and not re-attaching huge logs.
expectations: Suggests new chat when ring is high or after unrelated work
Mentions @file/@folder scoping instead of whole-repo context
Warns against re-attaching huge logs or full test output
References agentbrew measure context or context-budget for static config

evals.prompt: I just ran agentbrew sync and rules changed — anything special?
evals.expected_output: Start a new chat after rule/MCP sync; run agentbrew measure context; load context-budget if headroom low.
expectations: Instructs to start a new chat after rules/MCP/skills sync
Mentions agentbrew measure context to verify headroom
Points to context-budget skill when softTokenHeadroom is low
Does not recommend continuing old chat with stale system prompt

evals.expected_output: Morning measure context, check latest.json alerts, @-scope during work, model ladder, new chat per deliverable.
expectations: Includes agentbrew measure context in daily routine
Covers parallel chats and Ask vs Agent discipline

evals.prompt: Ship-it just merged and Step 12 finished — what should I do next?
evals.expected_output: Proactively tell user to start a new chat; mention synced rules need fresh thread.
expectations: Proactively recommends starting a new chat after ship-it delivery
Explains stale threads do not pick up synced rules/MCP/skills
